Grok @Bot

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Dylan (@dkmitc); megjelent: 2026-11-02T21:57:13+00:00; link: https://x.com/dkmitc/status/2117375502285721792; média: videó, 113 másodperc]
I had my Grok Bot shop around new Auto Insurance. It couldn’t find info about Progressives Glass coverage and as all Tesla owners know Windshield replacements can be pricey. I had Grok Bot call Progressive and get additional information for me all while I picked my kids up from school without me ever having to talk to a person. 

Here is the transcript and actual recording from the call. Personal info was bleeped and some parts cut for time. While there’s some improvements that can be made it got the job done. 

My mind is thoroughly blown!
